errors.description: Slope of the long lower run of the pocket mouth. Drawing: the run from the squared corner to its inboard terminus falls 43px over 337px of horizontal travel, about 7 degrees below horizontal and about 12 against the drawn waistband edge. Render: the same run falls about 88px over 222px, about 22 degrees below horizontal and about 25 against the waistband. Close to double the drawn rake.
errors.expected: A long almost level run raking about 7 degrees below horizontal
errors.actual: A distinctly diagonal run raking about 22 degrees
errors.correction: Render the lower run of the pocket mouth as a nearly level line that drops only about one eighth of its own length as it travels inboard, so it reads as a shallow shelf roughly parallel to the waistband rather than a slash.

errors.description: Mouth length normalised to belt-loop spacing, the one landmark present in both images. Drawing: mouth run 337px against 463px between the side loop and the next, ratio 0.73. Render: 222px against 365px, ratio 0.61. Roughly 16 percent short.
errors.expected: Mouth run about three quarters of the belt-loop pitch, reaching in to the front crease
errors.actual: About six tenths of loop pitch, stopping about an eighth of loop spacing outboard of the crease
errors.correction: Extend the pocket mouth inboard until its terminus lands directly on the pressed front crease, giving a run about three quarters of the belt-loop pitch.

errors.description: Depth of the squared vertical segment at the outer end. Normalised to waistband depth: drawing shows a vertical drop of 77px against a waistband depth of 88px, ratio 0.87. Render shows about 34px against about 104px, ratio 0.33 - under half of what makes the pocket read as SQUARE.
errors.expected: A deep vertical squared segment dropping roughly the full depth of the waistband before the mouth turns inboard
errors.actual: A shallow vertical stub about a third of waistband depth, so the corner reads as a soft kink rather than a squared corner
errors.correction: Render the outer end as a crisp right-angled corner where a vertical segment as deep as the waistband drops from the waistband seam and then turns hard inboard, giving the L-shaped mouth its squared character.

notes:
The rivets are gone - unambiguous, no hardware anywhere.

SPEC-VERSUS-DRAWING CONFLICT, verified directly: spec.json's description calls for a pocket 'reinforced with rivets and topstitching' and spec.measured.flags carries 'top stitch', while the drawing is plain line work with no hardware and no topstitch dashes. Graded to the DRAWING as the sole authority. The render also carries no topstitching, which agrees with the drawing and contradicts the spec flag. The spec text needs correcting or the conflict will keep re-injecting rivets on every rebuild.

NOT measurable: any centimetre figure - the drawing carries no dimension callouts, so every figure above is a ratio against belt-loop pitch or waistband depth. Also unresolved: some of the 7-to-22-degree rake gap may be foreshortening from the render's tighter three-quarter perspective, but not all of it, since the waistband sits at a comparable angle in both.
